claims.assertion: Mari reports an Etorthan delegation arrived on December 31, 2023, to audit Federation activity around Earth.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa

claims.assertion: Mari and the Urmah describe Etorthans as cold and untrustworthy, citing alleged past manipulations and broken promises.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa, relaying Urmah views

claims.assertion: Alenym declined Etorthan meetings, citing alleged covert telepathic influence; Mari says attendance was limited to invited representatives.
claims.speaker: Alenym and Mari Swa

claims.assertion: Mari speculated that a January 1, 2024 earthquake in Japan might have been an offering to returning Etorthans.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa
claims.qualifiers: She explicitly said they could not know this for certain.

review_flags: Mari's earthquake-as-offering theory is explicitly speculative and unverified.
coverage_gaps: the alleged earthquake-generating technology and other geopolitical claims
